title: mammillaria sanchez-mejoradae subsp. breviplumosa

The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels and reduce inflammation. It is believed to have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins.
